uutiset.s: Crunch Fitness sold $800 million of asset backed securities on Thursday, the latest in a recent streak of whole-business bond deals.

uutiset.t: Fed Tells Regional Staff to Expect Lower Pay Hikes in 2027
uutiset.s: The Federal Reserve has warned employees at its regional outposts to expect lower pay increases next year, according to a memo viewed by Bloomberg News.

uutiset.t: Lina Khan’s Economic Playbook Shows in NYC Revenue-Share Deals
uutiset.s: Lina Khan, the former US antitrust enforcer who Mayor Zohran Mamdani tapped for a top economic development role, is putting her stamp on New York City’s approach to stoking growth and hiring.

uutiset.t: Offshore Chinese Yuan Drops to Weakest Level in Over a Month
uutiset.s: The offshore Chinese yuan declined to the weakest level in more than a month while the dollar rallied as risk appetite shrank.

uutiset.t: Alphabet Set to Raise $4.2 Billion From Latest Canada Bond Sale
uutiset.s: Alphabet Inc. has launched a C$6 billion ($4.2 billion) sale of Canadian bonds, six months after its debut in the market.

uutiset.t: AMD Falls on Hunterbrook Short Call That Cites China Risks
uutiset.s: Advanced Micro Devices Inc. shares slid after Hunterbrook Capital said it shorted the stock, following a report by its media affiliate that the chipmaker is reliant on a potentially risky business in China.

uutiset.t: Tod’s Nears €400 Million Debt Refinancing Backed by Owners
uutiset.s: Tod’s SpA is close to securing a €400 million ($439 million) debt refinancing backstopped by the founder’s family that would ease financial pressure on the Italian luxury group, according to people familiar with the matter.

uutiset.t: Mexican Peso Rout Deepens as Banxico, Fed Policies Diverge
uutiset.s: The Mexican peso sank past the 19-per-dollar mark to its lowest in over a year, as the prospect of further Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes intensified a selloff fueled by Mexico’s dovish monetary policy.

uutiset.t: Anthropic Shares Jump 17% After $107.3 Billion IPO Breaks Record
uutiset.s: Anthropic PBC shares pared earlier gains to trade 17% above their IPO price after the artificial intelligence lab’s blockbuster $107.3 billion debut broke SpaceX’s record for the biggest-ever offering.

uutiset.t: India Customs Dispute Holds Up $66 Million of Scotch Whisky
uutiset.s: Indian customs authorities are holding up bulk Scotch whisky shipments worth more than £50 million ($65.8 million) at various ports over an import duty dispute, said a person familiar with the matter.
